summary: Frontend-only shell regression completed on public preview URL. Covered sidebar/topbar/statusbar behavior across desktop (1920x800, 1440x900, 1280x800) and mobile widths (900→320), including zoom 100/125/150, nav states, collapse persistence, search/notifications interactions, popup fit, footer labels, and logout/re-login. Unit tests for css-split/nav-prefs/commands passed (23/23).

action_items: Verify and stabilize splash/app-ready transition under 150% zoom (especially 1280x800) to avoid intermittent false-ready/late-ready states.

Shell flows are well-instrumented with data-testid overall; file lifecycle (add->present->remove) still lacks straightforward deterministic selectors from shell-level tests.
